expressions: /* Fn lock for the Logitech K400 family, sent by the hidout module using the table in expression 8 */ eol /* keyboard model: 0x1 = K400 or K400r, 0x2 = K400 Plus */ eol 0x1 2000 store eol /* Fn lock at boot: 0x1 = F-keys first, 0x2 = media keys first */ eol 6000 recall 0 eq 0x1 6000 recall ifte 6000 store eol /* Fn+Esc (reported as Power) toggles it */ eol 0x00070066 input_state_binary 0x00070066 prev_input_state_binary not mul eol 0x3 6000 recall sub 6000 recall ifte 6000 store eol /* select table line 0-3 (bit 0x1-0x8); 0 for one tick every 5 s so it is sent again after the keyboard was off */ eol 2000 recall 0x1 eq 6000 recall 0x1 eq 0x1 0x2 ifte 6000 recall 0x1 eq 0x4 0x8 ifte ifte eol time_sec 5000 mod 1 lt not mul 1000 store

/* hidout table, one message per line: length in bytes, the report as 32-bit words (report ID first), then the target devices */ eol /* line 0: K400 / K400r, F-keys first (FN_INVERSION at index 0F, confirmed on a K400r) */ eol 7000 0x10010F1A 0x00000000 0x046DC52B eol /* line 1: K400 / K400r, media keys first */ eol 7000 0x10010F1A 0x01000000 0x046DC52B eol /* line 2: K400 Plus, F-keys first (index 09, from k400p-fn-lock-win, not tested here) */ eol 7000 0x10010919 0x00000000 0x046DC52B eol /* line 3: K400 Plus, media keys first */ eol 7000 0x10010918 0x01000000 0x046DC52B
